# Gemini Web MCP: agent reference

> Verified baseline: [v0.24.2](https://github.com/Luckycat133/gemini-web-mcp/releases/tag/v0.24.2). This is a Gemini Web integration, not the official paid Gemini API. Upstream feature availability and quota depend on the account.

## Install and connect

Use Python 3.11 or later. Download the v0.24.2 wheel from GitHub Releases and install it in an isolated venv:

```bash
python3 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/python -m pip install ./gemini_mcp_server-0.24.2-py3-none-any.whl
.venv/bin/gemini-web-cli --version
```

Configure the client's stdio entry with the absolute installed command path, for example:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "gemini-web": {
      "command": "/absolute/path/to/.venv/bin/gemini-web-mcp",
      "args": []
    }
  }
}
```

The released project supplies two executables: `gemini-web-mcp` (the unified stdio MCP server) and `gemini-web-cli` (explicit account commands, including notebooks, history, preferences, and cleanup). Discover command usage with `gemini-web-cli --help`. Client-managed credentials belong in the host environment or an authorized local credential source, not inline in a shareable configuration. Use `GEMINI_BROWSER_AUTO_LOAD=false` and `GEMINI_AUTO_REFRESH=false` for offline checks; set `GEMINI_TASK_AUTO_APPROVE=false` and `GEMINI_TASK_WEB_APPROVALS=false` explicitly when testing without approvals.

## Unified public tools

| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `ask-gemini` | Chat, multi-turn sessions, NotebookLM questions, and up to 16 mixed inputs. Use `start_session=true` to start a session and its `session_id` to continue. |
| `generate-image` | Generate an image or edit from local references or a previous operation. |
| `generate-video` | Generate Web video with supported duration and aspect ratio. |
| `generate-music` | Generate music with supported duration, vocals and genre options. |
| `run-research` | Start Deep Research or derive supported outputs from the exact completed research operation. |
| `run-task` | Start or answer an explicitly requested long-running Task. |
| `get-operation` | Read status or recover output using its original operation handle; does not repeat generation. |
| `check-quota` | Read the account's 5-hour and weekly quota windows when available. |

Use `tools/list` as the authority for current input and output JSON Schemas, defaults and annotations. Invalid wire arguments fail before dispatch. Successful structured output is checked against the advertised schema; a response-validation error alone does not tell you whether upstream work has occurred.

## Recovery and migration

- `AUTH_EXPIRED`: restore access to the same Gemini Web account. Preserve any existing handle and check its state before resubmitting.
- `RATE_LIMITED`: use reported retry/reset metadata when present; do not retry in a tight loop. Quota may be unavailable or have no exact reset.
- The offline migration contract pins [agent-skills-setup v0.11.1](https://github.com/Luckycat133/skills-repo/tree/v0.11.1). It checks temporary Cursor-to-Codex preview, apply, and no-op; credential values are redacted to environment variable names, and the migrated config launches the installed MCP command. This is not live account or native editor validation.

See [verification contracts](docs/agent-verification.md), [README](README.md), and [license](LICENSE) (AGPL-3.0-only).
